statement: OpenPuck builds a 63-byte payload for input report 1: sticks at payload 0..3, hat/face at 4, shoulders at 5, triggers at 7/8, and an active touch sample at 32..41. Each contact packs a 7-bit ID, inactive bit 7, and 12-bit little-endian X/Y coordinates. This describes implementation fields, not physical equivalence.

applicability.scope: pinned compatibility implementation; active-contact fixture only
